summary: This Form 8-K filed by Golub Capital Private Income Fund S reports routine operational items: an unregistered sale of 65,768 common shares at $24.10 NAV per share for $1.585 million consideration, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D, with no underwriting commissions; a regular April 2026 monthly distribution of $0.1667 per share (net $0.1499) payable to record holders; and a portfolio update as of March 31, 2026, showing $243 million fair value across 135 companies (98% first-lien senior secured, 100% floating-rate debt). None of these items constitute a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. The filing is a standard periodic update with no transformative corporate action.
